verdict.rationale: Privacy controls such as telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out are a fair question for a SaaS conversion service, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no telemetry or analytics opt-out. Related items, such as fixed-region selection and team billing where 'files and conversions remain private', are adjacent features and do not deliver this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
